rationale: Confirm all five. T03-10: the diamond bound is at most one evidenced spawn origin, not a known count of zero. D is an existing delegate target, so no spawn edge in the fixture does not prove the origin is absent; spawn_origin_of_d is unknown. The two delegate_existing edges still contribute zero spawn origins. T03-14: corrections_at_cutoff_v1 selects revisions by ingestion at cutoff. Rename only; the value stays refuse. Null deletes the old key and is not a new status. T03-09: u2 [6,7) overlaps both assignment intervals, so attachment to asg-b stays only because membership is source-asserted; time overlap alone is refuse. u3 stays unattached to either assignment and is retained shared/unattributed, not dropped. Intervals and attachment arrays are unchanged. T03-16: equality, revision comparison, serialization, and hashing use the normalized canonical amount, while reported source precision remains separate metadata. Existing iso_scale_rewrites_canonical refuse stands. Coefficients, zero, negative canonical amounts, and display 2 are unchanged. T03-18: observed_count 0 counts eligible facts in the query window. The two accepted encountered records are outside that window or otherwise noneligible, so they are not rewritten as zero accepted. Acceptance of encountered stays 2/4.
